title: ASETTFX template metadata (v1)
description: JSON stored in the PNG tEXt chunk with keyword 'asettfx'. ASCII only. Readers ignore unknown top-level keys.

mode.description: mono: every advance is cell.w. var: advance comes from the width markers or from the ink.

widthSource.description: var mode only. magenta: advance = non-marker columns. auto: advance = ink extent, markers ignored.

ink.description: dark (default): ink is darker than the background, as in black on white. light: the opposite, for images drawn light on dark.

marker.description: Width marker color. Fixed to pure magenta in v1.

map.description: Code points in reading order, one token per run. 'XXXX' is one code point, 'XXXX-YYYY' an inclusive range (hex, 4 to 6 digits), '_' one unassigned cell. Cells after the last token are unassigned. The total must not exceed cols*rows.

baseline.description: Pixel rows below the baseline inside a cell (descender depth).

spacing.description: Extra pixels added to every advance.

guide.description: How the template image was drawn. Informational, never read by the exporter, which only reads the visible layers.

prefill.description: Variable mode only. The template image contains magenta width columns derived from the hint font.
